newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates ease, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates ease, seen falling.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates eased on Monday on selling pressure from ginners and are likely to open lower on Tuesday, dealers said.
The rates eased as ginning factories were keen to sell unload unsold stocks of 1.6 million 375-lb bales of cotton, dealer Abdul Kadir Kashan at the Karachi Cotton Association (KCA) said.
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was quoted between 2,225 and 2,350 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), the K-68 between 2,500 and 2,525 and the MNH-93 between 2,500 and 2,550, he said.
